from solution import convert_list_dictionary


def test_issue_example_exact():
    """Issue example maps ids, names and scores to nested dicts."""
    # hand-built pairing 0..3, values copied as-is: 85=85, 98=98, 89=89, 92=92
    expected = [{'S001': {'Adina Park': 85}}, {'S002': {'Leyton Marsh': 98}}, {'S003': {'Duncan Boyle': 89}}, {'S004': {'Saim Richards': 92}}]
    assert convert_list_dictionary(["S001", "S002", "S003", "S004"], ["Adina Park", "Leyton Marsh", "Duncan Boyle", "Saim Richards"], [85, 98, 89, 92]) == expected


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Convert more than one list to nested dictionary with one element."""
    # hand-built: 1 element, 0+1=1, value copied as-is: 100=100
    expected = [{"A1": {"Zoe": 100}}]
    assert convert_list_dictionary(["A1"], ["Zoe"], [100]) == expected


def test_issue_empty_inputs():
    """Convert more than one list to nested dictionary with empty inputs."""
    # hand-built: 0 elements, 0+0=0
    expected = []
    assert convert_list_dictionary([], [], []) == expected


def test_issue_two_elements():
    """Convert more than one list to nested dictionary with two elements."""
    # hand-built pairs 0..1, values copied as-is: 70=70, 80=80
    expected = [{"id1": {"Ann": 70}}, {"id2": {"Ben": 80}}]
    assert convert_list_dictionary(["id1", "id2"], ["Ann", "Ben"], [70, 80]) == expected


def test_issue_preserves_input_order():
    """Convert more than one list to nested dictionary keeps input order."""
    # hand-built order 0,1,2 kept: 3=3, 2=2, 1=1
    expected = [{"z": {"Zed": 3}}, {"a": {"Aye": 2}}, {"m": {"Em": 1}}]
    assert convert_list_dictionary(["z", "a", "m"], ["Zed", "Aye", "Em"], [3, 2, 1]) == expected


def test_issue_zero_negative_float_values():
    """Convert more than one list to nested dictionary preserves values exactly."""
    # hand-built values copied as-is: 0=0, -5=-5, 9.5=9.5
    expected = [{"k1": {"n1": 0}}, {"k2": {"n2": -5}}, {"k3": {"n3": 9.5}}]
    assert convert_list_dictionary(["k1", "k2", "k3"], ["n1", "n2", "n3"], [0, -5, 9.5]) == expected


def test_issue_duplicate_outer_keys_kept_separate():
    """Convert more than one list to nested dictionary keeps duplicate keys separate."""
    # hand-built 2 entries kept separate: 1+1=2, values 1=1, 2=2
    expected = [{"X": {"p": 1}}, {"X": {"q": 2}}]
    assert convert_list_dictionary(["X", "X"], ["p", "q"], [1, 2]) == expected


def test_issue_integer_outer_keys():
    """Convert more than one list to nested dictionary works with integer keys."""
    # hand-built pairs 0..1, values copied as-is: 10=10, 20=20
    expected = [{1: {"a": 10}}, {2: {"b": 20}}]
    assert convert_list_dictionary([1, 2], ["a", "b"], [10, 20]) == expected


def test_contract_result_length_matches_inputs():
    """Result is a list with one nested dict per input position."""
    # hand-built 3 positions: 1+2=3, values 1=1, 2=2, 3=3
    expected = [{"a": {"x": 1}}, {"b": {"y": 2}}, {"c": {"z": 3}}]
    assert convert_list_dictionary(["a", "b", "c"], ["x", "y", "z"], [1, 2, 3]) == expected


def test_contract_nested_dict_shape():
    """Each result element is a nested dictionary {l1: {l2: l3}}."""
    # hand-built nesting k->n->0, value copied as-is: 0=0
    expected = [{"k": {"n": 0}}]
    assert convert_list_dictionary(["k"], ["n"], [0]) == expected
